sloka: कर्णनासाविहीनस्तु कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः।रराज शोणितैः सिक्तो गिरिः प्रस्रवणैरिव ।। ६.६७.९० ।।
transliteration: karṇanāsāvihīnastu kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ।rarāja śoṇitaiḥ sikto giriḥ prasravaṇairiva ।। 6.67.90 ।।

translations.english: Dropped on the ground by Kumbhakarna of dreadful strength, pressed against the ground surface, Sugriva bounced to the sky to get reunited with Rama.
